purpose: Three authored, reference-guided semantic designs for a bounded visual-quality proof. References provide construction lessons only; no source coordinates, pixels, palette values, logos, or costume layouts are copied.

garments.name: Harborfold Camp Shirt

reference.sourcePath: ref_codex/masc clothing/[FS] Luny's Cottagecore Shirts/Shirts/Casual Button-up Shirt
reference.selectedBecause: Its larger relaxed footprint, folded collar, shaped side edge, and longer rounded rear hem preserve casual-shirt identity outside the front view.

garments.designConcept: A breezy harbor-market shirt with a soft camp collar and curved split shirttail.

silhouette.torsoMass: regular upper chest easing into a softly widened lower woven body
silhouette.proportion: normal length inside the safe upper-body envelope
silhouette.contour: shaped shoulders, gently convex side seam, curved split hem

garments.collarNeckline: wide two-piece camp collar around a shallow open neck; no necktie or narrow V stamp
garments.opening: short open upper placket that settles into a quiet buttoned woven front rather than a full contrasting stripe
garments.layering: single woven garment with a small visible neck recess; no broad inner-shirt insert
garments.sleeves: native Farmer sleeves colored as the shirt fabric; clean folded cuff bridge
garments.hemWaist: rounded shirttail with small directional side split and a slightly lower-looking rear termination
garments.panelsPockets: one integrated chest pocket and a broad rear yoke with center box-pleat carrier
garments.front: camp collar and off-open neck lead into an interrupted placket; pocket balances the opening without mirroring it
garments.rightLeft: collar depth, pocket edge on the appropriate side, convex hanging seam, and visible side split retain the draped shirt read
garments.back: wide shallow collar band, broad shoulder yoke, short box pleat, and curved rear hem; no front placket mirrored onto the back
garments.colorTopology: fog-aqua main cloth, sand undercollar and neck recess, harbor-teal construction edges, one tiny coral pocket tab
garments.originalityChanges: The source's exact white/gray arrangement and pixel layout are discarded; the new design uses a camp collar, one-pocket asymmetry, box pleat, coastal role topology, and newly authored four-direction proportions.

garments.name: Alderwick Knit Vest

reference.sourcePath: ref_codex/masc clothing/FS Gentlemans Collection.zip :: Shirts/Brown Sweater Vest
reference.selectedBecause: Its deep V, quiet sleeveless knit mass, visible shirt sleeves, and coherent plain back create a strong layered article with very few pixels.

garments.designConcept: A light academic knit vest shaped around a crisp woven shirt layer.

silhouette.torsoMass: compact knit body with visibly cut-in armholes
silhouette.proportion: normal length with a firm ribbed band
silhouette.contour: narrow shoulder straps, defined armhole scoops, slight waist taper

garments.collarNeckline: broad deep V with a two-cell knit binding and a visible folded inner-shirt collar
garments.opening: closed pullover knit; the V is neckline topology, not an open cardigan or zipper
garments.layering: cream knit shell over a pale woven shirt; inner collar and native shirt sleeves remain substantial
garments.sleeves: vest is sleeveless; native Farmer sleeves use the inner woven-shirt ramp and stay fully animated
garments.hemWaist: continuous ribbed knit band with a shallow center ease, not a jacket hem
garments.panelsPockets: no pockets; two quiet vertical knit ribs flank a broad center field
garments.front: deep bound V and shirt collar dominate; restrained rib columns articulate knit structure without a crest or motif
garments.rightLeft: bound armhole curve, knit side seam, shirt sleeve exposure, and ribbed hem preserve vest layering
garments.back: shallow rounded rear neck band, plain coherent knit back, two upper-back shaping ribs, continuous hem
garments.colorTopology: warm cream knit is dominant, dusty plum binds neck and armholes, antique tan supports ribbing, pale shirt remains broad
garments.originalityChanges: The brown source colors and plain rectangular field are not reused; the new vest adds an original tapered contour, layered folded collar, wide ribbed binding, quiet paired ribs, and light-primary academic role layout.

garments.name: Bluecurrent Saddle Shell

reference.sourcePath: ref_codex/masc clothing/FS Gentlemans Collection.zip :: Shirts/Teal Windbreaker
reference.selectedBecause: Its high collar, boxy shell, broad upper paneling, native long sleeves, and disciplined plain back read as sport outerwear rather than another fitted jacket.

garments.designConcept: A bright technical shell built around a curved shoulder saddle and gathered lower band.

silhouette.torsoMass: broad upper shell with a slightly bloused body
silhouette.proportion: short regular shell ending in a gathered band
silhouette.contour: firm shoulder corners, full side depth, inward-gathered waist

garments.collarNeckline: tall guarded stand collar with a small recessed throat opening
garments.opening: short half-zip contained inside the collar and upper chest; no full-height center stripe
garments.layering: single technical shell with a small lining reveal only at the throat
garments.sleeves: native Farmer long sleeves use the primary shell ramp; dark ribbed cuffs make the attachment intentional
garments.hemWaist: wide gathered elastic band that pulls the boxy body inward
garments.panelsPockets: curved shoulder saddle/yoke, two low slant pocket entries, and side panels that continue around the body
garments.front: stand collar and short zip sit above a broad curved saddle; low pocket diagonals and gathered band carry the lower read
garments.rightLeft: collar projection, saddle termination, one slant pocket entry, full shell depth, and gathered band author each side
garments.back: broad curved rear saddle, uninterrupted main shell field, two short shaping seams, and continuous gathered band
garments.colorTopology: bright blue shell field, cream saddle/lining blocks, navy structural anchors and band, one localized orange zipper pull/tab
garments.originalityChanges: The teal reference palette and its exact vertical block layout are discarded; the new design uses a curved saddle, contained half-zip, slant pockets, gathered waist, blue/cream topology, and original directional reconstruction.
